yc-gitlab:greenhouse:8523640002.title: Executive Assistant
yc-gitlab:greenhouse:8523640002.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Executive Assistant, you will help the VP of Business Systems, VP of Support, and VP of Data stay focused on the highest-impact work. This role creates leverage by bringing structure to fast-moving priorities, managing critical logistics, and making sure information, next steps, and follow-through stay on track in a dynamic, all-remote environment. You will work closely with these three executives while partnering closely with a broader network of Executive Assistants across GitLab.

This is a strong fit if you enjoy turning ambiguity into clarity, using tools and systems to keep work moving, and anticipating needs before they become urgent. In your first year, you'll build strong working relationships, create reliable operating rhythms for each executive, and improve calendar management, travel coordination, reporting, meeting planning, recruiting coordination, and team logistics. You will also use AI tools to streamline routine work and improve information synthesis so the VPs can make better choices, faster.

What you’ll do

  • Support the VP of Business Systems, VP of Support, and VP of Data across scheduling, logistics, communication, and day-to-day execution so priorities stay on track and follow-through is clear.
  • Manage complex calendars by vetting requests, prioritizing meetings, proactively managing conflicting calendar times, recommending tradeoffs, ensuring appropriate spacing between meetings and breaks, and aligning schedules with GitLab meeting norms and practices to protect time for highest-impact work.
  • Prepare complete agendas from high-level meeting descriptions and linked materials so leaders are ready for internal and external meetings with the right context and decisions.
  • Maintain regular communication cadences with both leaders and proactively flag items that need review, decisions, or escalation so urgent issues are surfaced on time.
  • Track updates from direct reports, functional peers, and cross-functional partners so leaders have clear visibility into progress, dependencies, and upcoming deliverables.
  • Coordinate travel, including air and ground transportation, hotel bookings, visas, security-related needs, and supporting documentation so plans are accurate and ready when needed.
  • Process expense reports, monitor reimbursements, and handle administrative workflows with accuracy and timeliness so expenses stay current and compliant.
  • Partner with People Operations, IT, Security, recruiting teams, and other Executive Assistants to support onboarding, interview scheduling, team meetings, onsites, event planning, and coverage across the EBA community so team operations run smoothly.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience supporting senior leaders with complex calendars, travel, expenses, and shifting priorities across multiple workstreams.
  • Experience working in a technology environment.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, identify risks early, and manage work independently in an all-remote, fast-changing company.
  • Experience handling sensitive and confidential information while maintaining accurate schedules, documentation, and administrative workflows.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfort using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Navan, Reclaim.ai (not critical), and similar administrative or expense platforms.
  • Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into useful agendas, summaries, trackers, and preparation materials for leadership decisions.
  • Experience collaborating across functions and with people from different backgrounds, with transferable experience from administrative support, project coordination, or related operational roles also welcomed.

About the team

We work across GitLab's organization in Business Systems, Support, and Data functions. You will work closely with senior leaders, their direct teams, and our broader group of Executive Assistants who collaborate asynchronously across regions to keep work moving smoothly in an all-remote environment. We value clear communication, strong prioritization, and dependable follow-through as we support fast-moving work and cross-functional coordination throughout GitLab.

How GitLab will support you

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave 
  • Home office support

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$78,000—$130,000 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
